# Dean Family Beach House (gulf-shores-beach-house.com)

> Beachfront vacation rental house in Fort Morgan / Gulf Shores, Alabama.
> Book direct with the owners — no middleman fees.

## Property facts
- Name: Dean Family Beach House (also known as "Jubilee")
- Type: Private beach house vacation rental, ~2,000 sq ft
- Address: 5993 Beach Boulevard, Fort Morgan, AL 36542, USA
- Location: Fort Morgan peninsula, about 25 minutes west of Downtown Gulf Shores, Alabama; steps from the Gulf of Mexico beach with gorgeous Gulf views
- Sleeps: 10 guests
- Bedrooms: 3 (Primary: 1 king + 1 full bed; Bedroom 2: queen; Bedroom 3: 4 bunk beds) — TV in every room
- Bathrooms: 2 full (walk-in shower and tub/shower), plus enclosed outdoor shower
- Amenities: free Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, air conditioning, smart TVs, beach chairs and beach cart provided, fish-cleaning table, picnic table, covered parking, keyless entry, two Gulf-facing decks

## Rates (2026 season, per night)
- Summer (late May – early August): from $400/night, 7-night Saturday-to-Saturday minimum
- Spring: from $375/night; Fall: from $350/night (3-night minimum)
- Winter (snowbird season): from $325/night, weekly or monthly stays welcome
- Taxes, cleaning fee, and refundable deposit additional; rental agreement required

## Booking
- Website (availability calendar + one-click booking form): https://gulf-shores-beach-house.com/
- Phone: (618) 954-9645
- Guest rating: 5/5 from verified guests
